value_set_change.note: the SINGLE value-set change of the whole deletion, flagged because it is the one place a second deletion could hide. named_mismatches: the control has one renaming generator fewer than the unnamed reading: the side exchange has no side-free statement

G4.name: verdict_replay_agrees

G5.name: forgetful_lemma
G5.sign_consequence: the pinned minimum is at most the side-free minimum, so a negative difference is unreachable and a tie is the strongest statement available against the admitted primitive
G5.what_it_catches: any structure the side-free carrier keeps beyond forgetting shrinks its automorphism set below the image of the side-typed one, so the lemma fails by name at a named cell

removed_refusal.pinned_refusal: an admission naming the other side would move an already admitted mark, and is refused by name
removed_refusal.why: it has no side-free statement at all: with no sides there is nowhere to move a mark to.  It is recorded here rather than quietly folded into the no-op, and its computed consequence is reported beside the two identity policies

removed_refusal_computed_consequence.note: the pinned refusal fired when the second admission named the OTHER side.  There is no other side here, so the no-op is the whole of what is left, and nothing was absorbed into it

shared_policy.name: shared identity: an admission names the mark its token names
shared_policy.reading: a REFUSAL OF THE SUBJECT, never a false and never a satisfied requirement: side-free the second admission is admit-then-no-op

key_choice_invariance.why_the_arity_is_declared: the pinned key keeps a tuple whose length is the arity, so both worlds get the arity free.  Of the TWO choices declared here, arity is the richer and empty the poorer, and a poorer key gives fewer distinctions and so more automorphisms: within this pair the declared choice is the more generous to this control, not the less.  What errs against the control is the scope the frozen design states -- the arity alone is the poorest DEFENSIBLE key, against richer keys that lie outside this pair and are not declared here.  Neither declared choice is load-bearing, and that is DEFINITION-level rather than a computed finding: a permitted renaming permutes indices and never changes the mark count, so the key is constant across the images under either choice and both admit the same automorphisms.  The rows below recompute every verdict under both

mirror.status: a COUNTERMODEL-DOMAIN object of this tree: its own re-declaration of a side-typed carrier, never claimed to be the pinned carrier, pinned against the pinned vector by G6, and a divergence VOIDS the run

observation_grammar.why_this_and_not_an_empty_grammar: the pinned side judgment is literally the conjunction of 'the mark is admitted' and 'its placement is that side', so this is the side-free conjunct of a pinned judgment: the honest residue, neither emptied nor enriched.  Unlike an absence it can be PROVED inert

open_obstructions.statement: whether the admission order is itself a container
open_obstructions.why_open: what pays for separation in a world with no container is the ADMISSION ORDER.  This control prices that route; it does not decide what kind of thing an order is

open_obstructions.statement: the price of re-purchasing a per-mark two-valued datum, which lies outside the pinned candidate space and is therefore priced in neither world
open_obstructions.why_open: allowing it would price a route the pinned world was never charged for either, and it answers a different question: the PRICE of rebuilding the admitted primitive, not the WORTH of having it free

open_obstructions.statement: the pinned premise that a candidate's permitted renamings are closed under composition and inverse
open_obstructions.why_open: inherited as OPEN, and not treated as discharged by the renaming set having shrunk

open_obstructions.statement: whether the requirement should have been declared so as to exclude a route that satisfies it by unfolding
open_obstructions.why_open: the pinned tree retains such a route and records this as OPEN; this control inherits it, counts the route in the primary answer, and freezes the secondary answer that excludes it

scored.quote: Four of the eight points carry
The minimum is **0** in all three
is `false` at every one of the eight points
**64 of 64** with the mark permutations withdrawn
separates the two retained marks at **no** cell
**P20 — G4 agrees on all fourteen rows.**

no price that the admission
order could not buy at the same price

predictions.tally_criterion: a HIT on a FORCED prediction is a hit by construction and is not counted as content; a miss on one is an implementation defect.  A miss is recorded next to its computed value and never edited away

requirement.declared: the two retained marks are internally separable exactly when no permitted automorphism of the regime carries one of them to the other
requirement.inherited_by: one declared textual deletion each, asserted byte for byte against the vendored bytes by G2
requirement.readings_agree_premise: the pinned premise that a candidate's permitted renamings are closed under composition and inverse is INHERITED AS OPEN and is not treated as discharged
requirement.second_reading: some property of a mark that forgets whatever the candidate's declared serialization forgets, and that is invariant under every permitted renaming, holds of one retained mark and not of the other

scope_limits: G4 covers the fourteen rows the minimum ranges over and is total over what the minimum is computed FROM, but not over all 48 points per reading, so a defect in a bundle row's recorded verdict is invisible to it.
The control is one rung wide and says nothing about what the admitted primitive bought at earlier rungs, nor about whether the requirement was the right one to impose.
The Lean package of this tree is a MANUAL RECEIPT: no CI job builds it, so its axiom report is unchecked by any gate.  Recorded as a live residual, not closed.
The link from the vendored bytes to the pinned commit is only as strong as that unmerged branch's reachability in the clone doing the checking.

second_measures.declaration: mu2 counts each carrier's OWN collateral facts and the two lists are not the same length, so a raw cross-world difference would charge the pinned world one unit for re-reporting the answer: the pinned receipt itself computes that its first collateral fact takes the requirement's value at every point of its space.  This receipt therefore carries NO cross-world mu2 difference field anywhere, and a test asserts it.  Only mu2_restricted, over the two facts both worlds can state, ever appears in a cross-carrier comparison

decided.plurality_is_not_price: routes and price are separate columns and are NEVER summed.  A test walks THIS receipt and requires that the only fields whose names carry both words are the two copies of this declaration itself, in the primary block and in the secondary one; a second test walks the price list's record and requires no such field there at all
decided.routes_bought_are_side_mediated: both of them: the withdrawal of the side exchange names the sides, and the further mark separates the two retained marks there because the two sides then carry different numbers of marks

secondary.declared_in_advance: frozen in PREDICTIONS.md before the enumeration ran, reported here, and NEVER deciding.  Both numbers are frozen precisely because the answer flips between them
secondary.rule: exclude every candidate that separates at every cell of its own world's route census, computed in both worlds by the same function over each world's own census
secondary.why_the_primary_counts_the_vacuous_route: excluding it in the control while it stands in the pinned world would itself be the rigging.  The pinned tree retains it and records whether the requirement should have been declared so as to exclude it as OPEN; this control inherits that as OPEN too

smuggle_tripwire.what_was_injected: the side re-admitted into the side-free key as a per-mark two-valued attribute -- exactly the substitute the lemma exists to catch.  This is a declared PARAMETER of the lemma function exercised deliberately, not an edit to any source file, so no receipt is written under a live source injection

terminal.sentence: Within the three declared coordinates, at the pinned requirement and prices, at the retained two-mark configuration, under mu1: the admitted primitive reduced the price of the required internal separation by ZERO under the unnamed reading and by ONE under the named reading.  What it bought under the unnamed reading is two additional routes at the same price, both mediated by the sides.  It bought no price that the admission order could not buy at the same price.
terminal.the_sentence_this_tree_may_not_write: the unscoped one, which drops the clause about the admission order.  What pays for separation in a world with no container is that order, and whether an order is itself a container is open obstruction (a)
terminal.why_the_tie_holds: only because a route that satisfies the requirement without reading anything is counted -- a route the pinned tree itself retains and itself records as OPEN

unmatched_pinned_routes.counterpart_note: there is none: withdrawing an exchange of two sides has no statement in a world with no sides
unmatched_pinned_routes.removed_because: its pinned capability sentence names the sides, so the mechanical criterion drops it

unmatched_pinned_routes.counterpart_note: the nearest surviving route of the same shape -- a name made internally available -- is keep_labels, and it FAILS in both worlds, so a naming route is worth nothing in either
unmatched_pinned_routes.removed_because: its pinned capability sentence names the sides, so the mechanical criterion drops it

what_this_is: the control the pinned derivation could not run from inside itself: the same requirement, at the same prices, in a carrier with no placement, no sides, and no admitted whole with two of them
